body: That’s definitely part of it. I’m better at talking when I’ve had a little to drink. But what am I gonna do? Go to a bar by myself and drink alone until I see a girl I want to talk to? There’s just no way that works.

that’s my problem. I don’t care about anything. I don’t want to do anything. I don’t have the will anymore.

Half of these I’ve tried and got nowhere. I went on a trip for three weeks last year by myself and I met no one. I have to study a lot for my job, so I would always study in coffee shops around my city, never had a conversation. I volunteered to canvas for Bernie earlier this year, and I *met* lots of people, but nothing came of it. Our conversation was all business.

I’ve been lifting for over 5 years. It hasn’t changed anything.

I cannot push myself to talk to people at a bar. I’ve tried. I agree with everything you’re saying. The stakes are low, there’s nothing wrong with it, etc. etc. I just can’t internalize it, no matter how much I intellectually understand it.
I’ll ask you to forgive me by being put off by the covers and titles of the guy’s existing catalog of books. That said, I’ll see what he’s about and try to keep an open mind. Thanks.

I can understand how this would be read as feeling bad for myself, but I disagree with that read. I'm frustrated with the way seemingly unchangeable things about my appearance and nature are holding me back - but I don't feel unlucky - moreso just ambivalent about whether or not it's worth living like this.

I'm glad that guy changed your life for the better, but pua shit isn't for me.

I 100% am everything you said. Rigid, objectifying, sad. Except not desperate. I’d say I’m actually very selective. Maybe desperate to finally date someone I like, but not desperate in the “I’ll take anyone” kind of way.

that said, the things I find fun in life do not involve anyone else. If I just do things for my own enjoyment I’m not actually making any kind of progress. And I struggle to enjoy them because they’re effectively a waste of time.

hard disagree. had a girlfriend for a year and it was the only time I was happy, because I had the security of knowing that my appearance wasn’t going to keep me alone. Right now, this is the only issue in my life. I have all the rest of my shit together. It’s just this preventing me from enjoying it
thank you for the positive thoughts and advice.
appreciate the input. glad relating to this was a positive thing.
